name: charfit-skill
description: Exact SMS segment counts for whole message batches, segment start positions, GSM-7 cleanup and strict EUC-KR Korean SMS/LMS byte limits.

plugins.name: charfit
plugins.description: Count and check text by SMS segment (single texts or JSONL batches), find where each segment starts, clean text to GSM-7, and check Korean SMS/LMS limits in strict EUC-KR. Also covers UTF-16/UTF-8 limits and an X approximation.
